The letter which has त् after or before it, besides referring to its own form, refers to those homogeneous letters which have the some prosodial length or time.

Terms: तपर-करणम्

चिण् is not the substitute of च्लि after the verb तप् 'to suffer' when used reflexively and when the sense of experiencing remorse.

Terms: च्लि

The agent of the verb तप् 'to heat', becomes similar to the object, only when the object is the word तपस् itself.

Terms: तप्

The affixes विनि and इनि come with the force of मतुप् after the words तपस् and सहर respectively.

Terms: विनि and इनि

Also त and तन (before both, on account of the indicatory प् the preceding vowel of the verbal अङ्ग (stem) is strengthened or if weak not shortened) तन and थन are substituted for the त of the 2nd person plural Imperative in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: छन्दस् substitution
